objective: Recheck retained CPVS membership evidence independently, harden acquisition of the published Table 4 reference, and preserve a fail-closed record of current scientific and CI outcomes.
previous_knowledge_consumed: Issue #170: exact CPVS reconstruction remains unresolved; 741,786 retained candidates versus 730,184 published members, with 11,602 candidate-only IDs and zero published-only IDs.
Issue #196 / PR #197: the retained diagnostic JSON contains non-standard NaN literals and requires a separate strict-JSON fix.

baseline.description: Frozen v0.2.0 scientific baseline and v1.0.1 release remain unchanged. Historical published membership is separately pinned to Zenodo 5764899; live reconstruction is diagnostic only.

change.scope: Workflow acquisition hardening and discrepancy-report documentation only. No model, feature, production selection rule, benchmark acceptance threshold, or released artifact changed.
change.rationale: Live VizieR/CDS reference acquisition timed out in the prior source-backed run; this PR adds multiple official endpoints and strict membership-count validation.

correctness.before: Retained-artifact recheck: 741786 unique candidate IDs, 730184 published IDs, 11602 candidate-only IDs, zero published-only IDs.
correctness.after: Current-head heavy run 40785255949 derived 741787 candidates; independent membership comparison did not run because reference acquisition failed.
correctness.evidence: PR #240 comments and Scientific Validation run 40785255949.

reliability.before: The prior current-head run could not reach the configured VizieR/CDS primary reference endpoint.
reliability.after: The multi-endpoint retry still could not connect to the configured VizieR/CDS hosts from the hosted runner; fallback acquisition failed closed.

reproducibility.before: Retained artifacts reproduce the 741786 candidate count.
reproducibility.after: Fresh source-backed derivation returned 741787; this one-object difference is not yet explained.
reproducibility.evidence: Retained artifact hashes recorded in PR #240 and current-head run 40785255949.

measurement.trade_off: Do not trade scientific integrity for CI success. External reference acquisition and the one-object count drift remain explicit blockers.

evidence: Run 40785255949: immutable historical ALeRCE and published CPVS reference archive checks passed.
Run 40785255949: CPVS derivation ran but produced 741787 candidates; live Table 4 acquisition failed across configured endpoints, so the independent membership audit could not execute.

PR #240 run 40785255959: Format Check and Lint passed; Cumulative Lifecycle Gate failed because the PR had no configs/process/cycles/*.json record, causing Test Suite, Runtime Smoke Tests, package build, and Dependency Audit to be skipped.
Product Scope Audit and CodeQL passed; neither establishes CPVS scientific validity.
validation.blocker: Use a verified immutable published-membership artifact in the derivation job or otherwise restore reliable reference acquisition; reconcile the 741786 versus 741787 candidate count; rerun full CI and inspect the independent membership audit.

root_causes: Operational failure in run 40785255949: all configured live VizieR/CDS reference endpoints timed out from the hosted runner.
CI lifecycle failure in run 40785255959: meaningful workflow/documentation changes were submitted without a machine-readable cumulative lifecycle record.
Scientific root cause of the 11602 candidate-only membership discrepancy remains unresolved; the four-field metadata predicate is diagnostic only.
The one-object difference between retained candidate evidence (741786) and current derivation (741787) remains unexplained.

findings: An immutable reference archive already exists in the benchmark registry at Zenodo 5764899; live VizieR should not be the only path available for an independent membership audit.
A successful download is not sufficient: the reference must pass the pinned publisher checksum and the parsed unique-ID contract.
Retained-artifact membership checks do not independently reproduce the candidate set from the original g/r archives.
CI lifecycle validation is a required gate; missing records skip downstream tests and dependency audits.
Do not change CPVS selection criteria to force cardinality equality.

open_blockers: Fresh current-head CI must complete lifecycle validation, the full test suite, runtime smoke tests, package build, and dependency audit.
Published Table 4 membership must be acquired and hash-verified from an immutable source for the independent audit.
The 741786 versus 741787 candidate-count difference must be traced to exact source bytes and per-object IDs.
The 11602 candidate-only IDs still require publisher-rule justification or an explicit documented limitation.

knowledge_carried_forward: Issue #170 remains open until the scientific selection semantics are source-supported or explicitly documented as unresolved.
Do not merge PR #240 until current-head CI and scientific evidence have been inspected.
Keep product-level validation separate from external CPVS exact-reconstruction evidence.
